[[File:Hobgoblin icon.png|left]]
'''Hobgoblins''' are [[Bandos]]ian creatures that share characteristics with both [[goblin]]s and [[ork]]s. They are [[aggressiveness|aggressive]]. The level 18 variants appear to be wielding spears.

The [[Edgeville Dungeon]] is a popular location for free-to-play players to find hobgoblins. They also reside in large numbers west of the [[Crafting Guild]] on the aptly-named [[Hobgoblin Peninsula]]. [[Hobgoblin (God Wars Dungeon)]] can also be found in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. Hobgoblins are often found in areas near water such as peninsulas, in caves, and in areas that contain [[limpwurt root]] spawns; they can drop these roots, making fighting hobgoblins an effective way to obtain them.

In the quest [[Fur 'n Seek]], [[hobgoblin skin]] must be collected and cleaned for the [[Odd Old Man]].

When killing hobgoblins, an [[hobgoblin (elite)|elite]] version may spawn (guaranteed while on a Slayer assignment), which can be further increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense stick]]s.

==Characteristics and history==
Hobgoblins are said to be similar to a cross between [[Goblin (monster)|goblins]] and [[ork]]s{{CiteGeneral|url=http://services.runescape.com/m=rswiki/en/Special:History?topicVersionId=39603&topic=God_Wars_Dungeon|title=God Wars Dungeon|quote=Hobgoblins are like a cross between a goblin and an ork, but they lack a goblin's tenacity and an ork's brute strength. They make up for this by being almost as numerous as the goblins but far stronger.|archivedate=23 March 2016|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/14871923}}, which were brought with the other Bandosian races from [[Yu'Biusk]] in the [[Second Age]].

Unlike goblins, hobgoblins have tusks, and they appear to be of lower intelligence than regular goblins; at least one intelligent [[hobgoblin geomancer]] exists in service of the [[Mahjarrat]] [[Bilrach]]; the geomancer keeps a [[hobgoblin scrawlings|diary]] and has built a shrine to Bandos. Hobgoblins are described as hardy but highly mobile {{wp|guerrilla}} soldiers.{{CiteLore|author=John Ayliff|title=History of the Goblins|url=https://www.runescape.com/lore/history-of-the-goblins|archivedate=30 September 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/11061035}}
{{clear|left}}

==Champion's Challenge==
Hobgoblins are one of the races with a champion in the [[Champion's Challenge]] Distraction and Diversion. To fight the [[Hobgoblin Champion]], the player must kill hobgoblins until one drops a [[Hobgoblin Champion's scroll]], a very rare drop.

==Trivia==
* A {{WP|hobgoblin}} is a household spirit from British folklore, being a more intelligent and helpful versions of {{wp|goblin}}s.
* In Armies of Gielinor hobgoblins are described as: "The hobgoblin occupies the rung on the evolutionary ladder between goblin and ork, and so displays the best and worst traits of both races."
* According to the [[Runescape Official Handbook]], hobgoblins keep their teeth sharp so they can eat their opponent.
* As of [[30 January]] [[2023]], hobgoblin Slayer assignments had the highest completion rate with over 99%.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Sponge|url=https://twitter.com/JagexSponge/status/1620148676239958018|date=30 January 2023|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/100367|archivedate=1 March 2023|quote=[Stat of the day (kinda) Which slayer task do you think has the highest completion rate (by percentage)?] Hobgoblins, the answer was hobgoblins. With above 99% completion rate.}}
